newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil mulls adding alcohol to diesel oil - report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil mulls adding alcohol to diesel oil - report.

text.p: Brazil is considering mixing alcohol with diesel oil in the same way that alcohol is currently mixed in with gasoline, the country's Industry and Commerce Minister said, according to private Invest News agency.
The idea has been sent to the Mines and Energy Ministry for evaluation and will then be discussed at an interministerial level, Invest News said.
All gasoline sold in Brazil at present contains 22 percent anhydrous alcohol.
President Fernando Henrique Cardoso raised the prospect of a renaissance in alcohol fuel as a solution to the world's pollution problems at last month's Earth Summit at the United Nations.

Brazilian officials also said last month that the government would set up an interministerial group to find ways of encouraging the use of alcohol as a vehicle fuel while another working group would evaluate existing proposals such as the introduction of a "green tax" on petroleum fuels.
Officials from the Industry and Commerce Ministry's sugar and alcohol department were not immediately available to comment on today's Invest News report.
